headline: M2: benchmark recovery and grant rebaseline are active.
detail: M1 is complete. The M2 evidence base remains materialized and integrity-validated for 100 suitable benchmark observations, with 820 unique historical records supporting 1,952 case-to-context relationships and all 820 evidence hashes verified. The last verified research artifact still records 0 of 100 human context-sufficiency decisions and no relationship ground-truth labels. Drift-governance automation has advanced separately, but it does not replace the unfinished benchmark work. The current priority is to complete the human context-sufficiency gate, freeze benchmark v0.1, and then run M3 baselines and M4 model evaluations.
next_gate: Complete the 100 human context-sufficiency decisions, expand evidence only where MORE_CONTEXT_REQUIRED, then complete relationship ground-truth adjudication and freeze benchmark v0.1.

schedule.note: The September 11 and September 18 dates are historical targets that were missed. October 2 remains an internal execution target, not an asserted external grant deadline.

public_private_boundary: Only aggregate research-progress counts are public. Private evidence packets, historical-context evidence, raw operational records, and case-level decisions are not exposed by this status artifact.
